title: Coral Coast Caravan
style: Australian comedy pop with swing-band bounce, polka-guitar flicks, beatboxed groove, goofy group chants, and playful male and female family vocals; verses trade jokes and character bits, pre-chorus strips to claps and harmonica stabs, chorus lands on a chanty hook with call-and-response doubles, then a bridge flips to half-time for a silly shout-out run. Bright, punchy, and wide with cheeky ear candy, handclaps, reverse swells, and cartoonish ad-lib throws., swing, comedy, bounce, happy, polka, oi, big band
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey happy smart core
Codes it out the door
Reversing, forward, upside down
Mrs Squiggle on the ground

Michelle on the pickleball court
Mishy Mish Mash, take the shot
Smack that ball, then laugh at me
"Easy, mate" — that's victory

Ruby roo roo, artist queen
My art stays with me, keen
Paint on hands, sand on toes
Coral Coast where the whole crew goes

[Pre-Chorus]
What's da pelican reckon?
He just nods and starts heckin'
Rotto quokka, tiny grin
Ready for the bounce we’re in

[Chorus]
Coral Coast caravan, all day
Never-ending holiday
Coral Coast caravan, hooray
(hooray) We’re rollin' Aussie way

Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, bring the cheer
Coral Coast caravan, all day
Never-ending holiday

[Verse 2]
Wesley on the gamer run
Wez, Wezza, never done
"Hola, bro" and "vamos!" too
Headshot, gg, que tal, boo

Ashley, where's Micha? gone
Off she goes, super dog speed, gone
Two dogs with lots of frogs
Leapin' through the damp green bogs

Pink and grey galah, Micha sings
Flaps round the awning, cheeky things
Black sniffer poodle, Aussie, too
Aussie, Aussie, aussie, sniffing through

[Pre-Chorus]
Mishy says, "Keep it tight"
Corey goes, "I built this right"
Kanga bounce in the van
Now the whole coastline’s got a plan

[Chorus]
Coral Coast caravan, all day
Never-ending holiday
Coral Coast caravan, hooray
(hooray) We’re rollin' Aussie way

Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, bring the cheer
Coral Coast caravan, all day
Never-ending holiday

[Bridge]
Coral Coast, we’re off the map
Beatbox clap and a silly yap
Sneaky phonk panther, local lore
Stalking snacks by the caravan door

Corey smart, Michelle's got pace
Ruby paints up every place
Wez goes "sí" and kicks it back
Family chaos, full attack

[Final Chorus]
Coral Coast caravan, all day
Never-ending holiday
Coral Coast caravan, hooray
(hooray) We’re rollin' Aussie way

What's da pelican reckon?
He said, "Mate, this is excellent"
Coral Coast caravan, all day
Never-ending holiday

Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, bring the cheer
Coral Coast caravan, all day
Never-ending holiday
